newsitem.title: USA: PRONET SAYS WINS PORTION OF TEXAS CONTRACT.
newsitem.headline: PRONET SAYS WINS PORTION OF TEXAS CONTRACT.

text.p: Pronet Inc said Thursday that it has been awarded a significant portion of a contract to provide paging services to the State of Texas.
Terms of the contract were not disclosed, Pronet said.
The company said in a statement that the contract is for a two-year period with three one-year extensions.
The terms included provide paging services for state agencies and selected non-state agencies that qualify to benefit from state contract rates.
